## Learning goals

By the end of this week, you should understand:

- what APIs are and how they differ from ordinary websites;
- how APIs provide structured access to data;
- why APIs have rules and technical limits that researchers need to consider; and
- how APIs can be used to collect, enrich, or transform research data.

## Preparation before class

- Review the relevant sections of the Python Bootcamp and Web Scraping 101.
- Make sure that you can access JupyterLab at [jupyterlab.uvt.nl](https://jupyterlab.uvt.nl/).

## Tutorials

### APIs 101

This tutorial introduces API requests, parameters, JSON responses, pagination, and storing API results.

### APIs Advanced

This tutorial uses an AI API to introduce authenticated requests, prompt-based data enrichment, additional endpoints, and embeddings.

API access may require a separate key or account. Follow the course instructions and never share API keys or commit them to a repository.

## After class

- Work through APIs 101 and APIs Advanced.
- Compare the strengths and limitations of scraping and APIs for your team project.
- Continue developing your project data-collection plan.
